title: Government Law College IPR Clinic
tagline: Grassroots Legal Literacy & Pro Bono Intellectual Property Advisory
vision: The IPR Clinic at Government Law College Mumbai operates as an academic incubator and advisory cell designed to demystify intellectual property for student creators, small business founders, independent artists, and emerging innovators.

mandate.title: Pro Bono Preliminary Guidance
mandate.description: Assisting student innovators and local creators in identifying protectable assets across patents, trademarks, design, and copyright.

mandate.title: Procedural Awareness & Filing Roadmap
mandate.description: Educating creators on statutory filing workflows under the Indian Trade Marks Registry, Patent Office, and Copyright Board.

mandate.title: Workshops for Campus Entrepreneurs
mandate.description: Conducting hands-on workshops on safeguarding brand identity, open-source compliance, and founder IP agreements.

mandate.title: Student Research Fellowships
mandate.description: Empowering GLC law students to gain hands-on clinical legal training under faculty mentorship.

disclaimer: The IPR Clinic provides academic information and preliminary intellectual property awareness for educational purposes. It does not substitute formal legal representation by an advocate.
